title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Wednesday, 11 November 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: COP31 outcome needs to prioritise transition away from fossil fuels
highlights.summary: Many countries are already working on parts of their transition, such as phasing out coal or ending fossil fuel subsidies, with more expected to follow soon The post COP31 outcome needs to prioritise transition away from fossil fuels appeared first on Climate Home News.

highlights.headline: Big fossil-fuel countries back Brazil-led transition roadmap
highlights.summary: Some countries including Germany and the Netherlands call for the roadmaps to inform a key global review of climate progress in 2028 The post Big fossil-fuel countries back Brazil-led transition roadmap appeared first on Climate Home News.

highlights.headline: Malaysia's disgraced former PM leaves jail for house arrest after embezzling millions
highlights.summary: Najib Razak was convicted for his role in the billion-dollar scandal involving the 1MDB sovereign wealth fund.

items.title: Watch: E-bike battery explodes into massive fireball inside Oregon home
items.description: Surveillance footage from inside the home shows a mother and son noticing smoke coming from the battery before it suddenly bursts into flames.

items.title: Why electrification is the climate game changer we need
items.description: From EVs and electric buses on the road, heat pumps warming homes and solar panels powering appliances, the shift to electrifying tech is already in full swing. But what exactly does "electrification" mean?

items.title: Will Australia push for fossil fuel exit at UN talks?
items.description: The heat is on Australia as chief negotiator at the COP31 UN climate conference to forge a path away from coal and gas, and to protect Pacific neighbors facing rising sea levels.

items.title: UK Privy Council overrules Trinidad and Tobago gay sex law
items.description: A London court has overturned a Trinidad and Tobago law criminalizing consensual sexual relations between male same-sex couples. As a result of the colonial legacy, it is the independent country's last court of appeal.
